versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\rutserv.exe'
        - '\rfusclient.exe'
    - Product: 'Remote Utilities'
filter:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\Remote Utilities'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Remote Utilities'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\rutserv.exe", "*\\rfusclient.exe") OR Product="Remote Utilities" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Remote Utilities*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Remote Utilities*"))
